evidence: During keyboard-only navigation using Tab and Shift+Tab, the Help dropdown did not receive keyboard focus. Focus moved from Contact Us to Sitemap, skipping Help.Evidence: 04-keyboard-contact-us-focused.png and 05-keyboard-help-skipped-sitemap-focused.png.
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may be unable to access the options in the Help dropdown.
recommended_fix: Make the Help control keyboard-focusable and ensure its dropdown can be opened and navigated using the keyboard.

evidence: Lighthouse reported "Links do not have a discernible name" and identified a#ContentPlaceHolderTop_OuterContentPlaceHolderBody_LinkButton1 as a failing element. Evidence: 07-lighthouse-links-no-discernible-name.png.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not be able to understand the purpose of the link from its accessible name.
recommended_fix: Give the link a clear and unique accessible name using meaningful link text or an appropriate accessible label.

evidence: Lighthouse reported that the html element does not have a lang attribute. Evidence: 08-lighthouse-html-lang-missing.png.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may receive incorrect pronunciation or language interpretation.
recommended_fix: Add the appropriate lang attribute to the root HTML element based on the primary language of the page.

evidence: Lighthouse reported that background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio and identified multiple failing SVG elements. Evidence: 09-lighthouse-color-contrast-failure.png.
user_impact: Users with low vision or color-vision difficulties may have difficulty reading or distinguishing low-contrast content.
recommended_fix: Adjust foreground and background color combinations to meet the required WCAG contrast ratio.

evidence: Lighthouse reported that touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing. Evidence: 10-lighthouse-touch-target-size.png.
user_impact: Users on touch devices, including users with motor difficulties, may have difficulty selecting small or closely spaced controls.
recommended_fix: Increase the size and spacing of interactive targets so they meet the applicable WCAG target-size requirements.
